title: Europe got its own TBPN-style live show, and everyone’s angling for a guest spot
snippet: On Monday, the network announced a $1.6 million seed round from top players in the media ecosystem, including Powerhouse Capital, Axel Springer SE (which owns Business Insider and Politico), the popular media publication LadBible, and angel investors from OpenAI and DeepMind. With this fresh capital, the network is announcing its largest expansion yet.

title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
